This code implements an end-to-end Telco Customer Churn analysis pipeline using the real Telco Customer Churn dataset. It loads and cleans the data, handles missing values and categorical features, performs exploratory data analysis, and uses K-Means clustering to segment customers into three groups based on their characteristics. It then builds a Random Forest classifier with hyperparameter tuning using RandomizedSearchCV to predict customer churn, and evaluates the model using classification metrics, a confusion matrix, ROC-AUC, ROC curve, and feature importance. The goal is to identify customer segments and predict which customers are more likely to churn.
